CORAL-ISLAND SAND SPIT — a narrow white coral-sand spit extending into brilliant teal shallows, frangipani trees heavy with white and gold blooms growing at the spit's base, sea-grape and beach morning-glory carpeting the sand's edges, the far lagoon receding in crisp sharp overlapping layers of clear flat water, blooms almost incandescent against the pale water.

MULTI-TIER CASCADE WATERFALL — three-tiered jungle waterfall with each shelf crowded by anthuriums, heliconias, and hanging orchids, fine spray crossing the upper tiers, palm fronds crossing the frame, the valley below receding in crisp sharp overlapping layers of tack-sharp green, the water white against the layered greens, bloom-masses at every rocky ledge catching the warm diffuse light.

COCONUT-GROVE BEACH TRANSITION — dense coconut grove sloping steeply to a white-sand beach, palm trunks creating layered recession toward the sea, beach morning-glory and sea-grape massing at the sand-line, hibiscus shrubs blazing red in the filtered grove-light, the ocean shining through the palm trunks in the middle distance.

RAINFOREST CANOPY SHAFT CLEARING — towering rainforest floor under buttress-root giants, warm golden light splitting the green canopy and illuminating specific heliconia and orchid patches below, the far distance receding in clearly-defined tack-sharp layers of clear air, moss and fern carpeting the floor, the upper canopy closing like a cathedral ceiling hundreds of feet overhead.

CLOUD-FOREST WATERFALL RIDGE — high-elevation cloud-forest waterfall cascading over moss-blanketed boulders, hanging orchids and bromeliads on the wet cliff-walls, clear crisp air at the tree-line, ferns dripping with condensation in the foreground, a valley of tack-sharp ridgelines stepping back in crisp overlapping layers below the ridge, the bloom-colors vivid against the deep green surrounds.

LAGOON WITH BLOOM-ISLAND — oval turquoise lagoon with a small vegetation island at its center, the island completely covered in tropical blooms and palms, calm water reflecting the island in near-perfect symmetry, the outer reef framing the scene, the horizon crisp and sharp in clean air, the bloom-island brilliant against the surrounding blue-green water.

TIDAL POOL BLOOM EDGE — rocky tropical tide-pool at low tide, vivid bougainvillea and hibiscus shrubs massing directly behind the pool on the coastal rock, palms angling from the shoreline, the open Pacific glittering in the background in crisp clear air, bloom-reflections trembling in the tidal pool's shallow water, the coast receding in clearly-defined crisp layers in both directions.

CENOTE TROPICAL SPRING — natural cenote cut into pale limestone, turquoise water lit from within, hanging vines and roots descending from the rim into the void, tropical blooms massing at the rim-edge, warm golden light penetrating the clear air and illuminating the water surface, the deep walls covered in ferns, orchids, and dripping moss.

WATERLILY PALM LAGOON — a wide shallow lagoon entirely covered in giant Victoria water-lilies and white lotus, palms tilted over the water along the far bank, tropical blooms blazing at the shoreline, the far rainforest receding in crisp sharp overlapping layers of tack-sharp canopy above the waterline, the lily-pads creating a green-on-blue geometry across the entire middle ground.

BEACH COVE WITH BLOOM-SHRUBS — a sheltered horseshoe cove of pale sand with yellow and red hibiscus shrubs growing thick at the high-tide line, coconut palms framing the scene, calm shallow water glowing aquamarine within the cove-walls, the headland cliffs receding in crisp sharp overlapping layers of clear air, the blooms crowding the boundary between sand and jungle.

EPIPHYTE-LADEN OLD GROWTH TREE — single massive tropical hardwood trunk filling the foreground, every branch-fork loaded with bromeliad chandeliers, hanging orchids cascading in long chains, mosses and lichens covering the bark, the dense humid jungle receding behind into deep green blur, a shaft of light catching one spectacular orchid bloom against the shadowed canopy.

ATOLL EDGE FRANGIPANI GROVE — low atoll-edge with frangipani trees in full bloom, white and yellow flowers dense overhead and fallen on the pale coral-sand, the inner lagoon visible through the grove in brilliant turquoise, the far reef line stepping back sharp and clearly defined in clean air, the sand scattered with fallen blooms creating a natural floral carpet at the water's edge.

PHILODENDRON CLIFF FACE — a towering vertical cliff draped entirely in giant philodendron, monstera, and climbing-vine mass, hanging orchids and bromeliads studding the rock face, the jungle floor below in deep shadow, a sliver of tropical coast visible in the far distance receding in crisp sharp overlapping layers of clear air, the bloom-colors explosive against the deep green vertical carpet.
